form: Sadaken ko tinakoan, o so'linay widang mamihinom kitanan, so'lin ano awa ko paro no loma' a mihaen to demak.
translation: Give an example of how true friends can bring comfort even when close relatives fail to do so.

form: Haratengen hena, ano misinanotan ni Yihofa ko awaay ko 'orip a masanga'ay, coko a ikaka ko kaciharateng Ningra to maolahay Cingranan a madimadiay sikawdan han?
translation: If Jehovah takes a personal interest in his inanimate creation, imagine how he feels about you who serve him, not because you have been programmed to do so, but because you love him!

form: Ano mitengil to lihaf no Hongti Kitakit, micekiw to Fangcalay Cudad ato mitepangan cudad, micada to pipacekiw to Fangcalay Cudad, misaday to lalakaw no sa'opo anca mirienang to sa'opo, oha mamipalak to toki.
translation: It takes time to listen to the Kingdom message, read the Bible and Bible literature, have a personal Bible study, and prepare for and attend congregation meetings.

form: Ano misaharateng kita to samaanan ni Yihofa miharateng ko finawlan Ningra, wa ira ko maanan a epoc hani?
translation: How can we benefit from Bible accounts about the way that Jehovah cares for his people?

form: Cowa aca ko polong no kitakit ko mihinoman ni Yihofa, ano o kahacecay a tamdaw mihinoman Ningra.
translation: Jehovah gave comfort not only to the nation of Israel as a whole but also to each individual.

form: Kawra, sowal ni Pawlo, ano o malaliyasay ko fafahi ato fa'inay i, 'cowa ka nga'ay miliyaw a ciramod.
translation: The problem was not, for example, that the husband had been immoral, giving the wife a basis for divorce and remarriage.

form: Cowa ko kafana' aca to capeling ni Yihofa, ano sinanoten ita to samaanay ci Yihofa padama kitaanan i, wa "ma'araw" ita ko Kawas.
translation: In addition to getting to know God's qualities, true worshippers can "see God" by observing the way he acts in their behalf.

form: Haratengen, ano tahapades i, mitafo to madimadi, papala'osi to manan a patosokan, mamasayarto ko faloco'.
translation: Why is it comforting to reflect on the value of our faithfulness?

form: Ano cowa pihakelong ko raramod iso, mamisamaan pasifana' to wawa to so'linay a kimad?
translation: How can Christian parents teach their children Bible truth in a religiously divided household?

form: Ano itini misanga' to tamina i 40, 50 miheca, misamacayay cingra to no'adingoan a demak.
translation: Even when building the ark, which may have taken as long as 40 or 50 years, Noah kept his spiritual focus.

form: Ano misi'ayaw to cowa pakaso'lin to misanga'ay Tatapang a tamdam i, samaan kita padama cangranan misaharaterateng?
translation: How could we reason with someone who claims that there is no Creator?

form: Ano sawkitento no mato'asay to malipalaway a mipatay cingra nga', patikoren cingra i pilimekan a niyaro'.
translation: Only after they had declared the killing accidental would the fugitive be returned to the city of refuge.

form: Ano midopo to satadamaanay noka pikowan no Kawas wa misamaan ko sa'osi ita?
translation: How do supporters of God's sovereignty make personal decisions?

form: Ano mihaen to demak kita, cowa ko mamatira toya padeteng sanay misafelit to palinian no Kawas a tamdaw, matefoc no Kawas.
translation: Thus, we may succeed in escaping Jehovah's judgment against those who deliberately violate his law.

form: Ano malipalaw a mipatay to tamdaw i, kalikien ningra milaliw tayra i pilimekan a niyaro', tayra i fawahan no niyaro', "pasowalen ko mato'asay no niyaro' to nano demak."
translation: After he accidentally killed someone, a fugitive first had to "present his case in the hearing of the elders" at the gate of the city of refuge to which he had fled.

form: Ano patahekal kita to olah, o mamisolot to tao sakafana'aw to Wama ita i kakarayan.
translation: The love we show for others draws people to our heavenly Father.

form: Ano caka pihakelong ko tamdaw to Kawas i, wa sao niyah saan misa'osi to maanan ko matatodongay maanan ko tatiihay."
translation: If they disobey, they will be left to decide for themselves what is good... and what is not good."

form: Ano madimadi kiso i, mamahemek ko faloco', samanen mamilifok kiso to hemek ni Yihofa aci Yis, hanaca o papalifonen nangra kiso.
translation: Find joy in knowing that Jehovah and Jesus are pleased with you and that they will reward your faithful course.

form: Ano cowa ko Krisciyang ko raramod iso, mamisamaan pasifana' to wawa mikangodo to wama wina?
translation: How can Christians teach their children to honor an unbelieving parent?

form: Ano patahekal kita to matiniay cowa pisateked a olah, o mamatomes to hemek ato epoc ko noka'orip ita.
translation: When we show or are shown unselfish love, our lives are enriched, being filled with joy and meaning.

form: Ano matongangan no tao kita sasamaan hani?
translation: What, though, if you are a victim of a slanderous accusation?

form: So'lin mipakideman miroero cangra, o Misawacayay Tamdaw ni Yihofa "o nga'ayay, damsayay tamdaw", ano maroero cangra "mitafoay to madimadi, makelecay cangra", sanay.
translation: Even so, despite the bitter persecution they endured, adds the author, the Witnesses showed "dependability and equanimity calmness under stress" as well as "integrity and solidarity."

form: Ano tikolen miharateng ko mieminay to toki a katayal, mata'lifay ko maharatengay to sapafeli ni Yihofa a sakaraheker.
translation: When I reflect on our life in the full-time service, I have the undeniable feeling that we were blessed by Jehovah beyond what we could have imagined.

form: So'lin ano caka pasowal cangra, latek mamatira ci Tafitian ko harateng nangra: 'Nanay pahemeken no tamdaw kiso to nika citanengay kiso!'
translation: Whether they verbalize it or not, they may feel like David, who said: "Blessed be your good sense!"

form: Mangalef ano mararaw kita tatiih ko teloc i, o pirikec ni Yihofa wa patalipa'elal kitanan, tada kalimelaan ko pihakelong to kakarayan a Wama.
translation: Moreover, if our actions caused unpleasant consequences, his discipline would remind us of just how important it is to listen to our heavenly Father.

form: Ano mafana' kita to midemakay ko salikaka to pakidemay misafelit to palinian no Fangcalay Cudad a demak, wa samaan ko hademak?
translation: What responsibility do we have when speaking to the elders about our brothers?

form: Ano midopo kiso to satadamaanay noka pikowan no Kawas, samaanay ko faloco' ni Yihofa?
translation: How does Jehovah feel about your efforts to uphold his sovereignty?

form: Sanay ci Yis: "Ano cima ko ci'anofay ko faloco' a minengneng to fafahiyan i, o ma'odangayto cingra i faloco' ningra toya fafahiyan.
translation: Jesus stated: "Everyone who keeps on looking at a woman so as to have a passion for her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

form: Paceremay kako ato kasakilac kantok a lomowad, ano malanam adihayay ko milengoan kahemekan a demak.
translation: "The circuit overseer and I got up early each morning and discussed many interesting topics over breakfast.

form: Ano mafana'to ko wawa mi'imer to tireng i, mihawadan midama to kapoto' a lalan.
translation: But as the child finds his balance, the parent cautiously lets go for a few moments at a time.

form: Ano ira ko fadangalan ita a mirikec, wa nga'ay kita misamaan mitodong ci Yihofaan aci Yisan?
translation: When we give discipline, how can we imitate Jehovah and his Son?

form: Ano ma'araw ita ko papadamaen a tamdaw i, wa mitodong ci Yisan paihekal to sida'it a ciharateng cangranan han?
translation: Are we like Jesus, ever ready to show compassionate concern when we meet people who need help?

form: Ano sapitongalaw kiso to tayal saki Yihofaan, iraay ko maanan a hatayal hani?
translation: What further opportunities exist if you desire to expand the work you do for Jehovah?

form: Ano mahaen i, hamaan patelas a misawkit cangraanan, tanamen miharateng ko roray nangra sini'ada cangraanan.
translation: But instead of judging them, let us show insight and compassion.

form: Kawra ano caka walawal no faloco' i, tanamen mikalasaka dademak ko safalod no Matay 18:15 a misaysay to demak.
translation: If after some effort it seems that more is needed, could Matthew 18:15 be applied in principle?

form: Mihaenay, ano mitosil paihkal to nga'ayay capeling no Krisciyang tada masakalimlaan.
translation: Clearly, the fruitage of God's spirit should be reflected in our ministry.

form: O safalod no sinael samanay padama takowanan, ano kalacafay to kafahalan a tamdaw itini i wangcan a misalama, wa nga'ay han?"
translation: Or what should you do if invited to play online games with strangers?

form: Ano mamilayap to sapadama no Kawas, cowa ka nga'ay kita misamaan to demak?
translation: To benefit from God's help, what should we avoid?

form: Ano o Hipray ato Krisiya a sowal no Fangcalay Cudad, adihayay ko nika falic.
translation: The same is true of Hebrew and Greek, the languages that most of the Bible was written in.

form: Ano samanayto, o nga'ayay a widang ita ano cowa ka pisaareteng to palinian ni Yihofa, o mamipalak to nga'ayay kalala'ed no mita ato Kawas alatek.
translation: In any case, if our close associates do not show a high regard for Jehovah's standards, they can in time destroy our good standing with God.

form: Ano mararid a mitosil kita, o papadadotoc a misamacay to sakalimlaan a demak.
translation: Continuing to have a regular share in Jehovah's work can help us to stay focused on the big issue.

form: Kawra ano samaanto, oha papatado kita a miharateng ato mikangodo to tamdaw, mahawpay ko kacipinang to mitosilan i kilac a tamdaw.
translation: However, we should always be considerate and respectful, which includes getting to know the local people well.

form: Ano ma'araw namo ko cecay fa'inayan i pikimadan to patay ako i, sacaciyawen cingra, nanay 'osien namo koni mimingay langdaway a cudad "Mikayatay to Saka Tahada'ocaw a Ma'orip".
translation: But if you see a man at my funeral who does not seem to belong there, talk to him, and please read this little blue book referring to the Bible study aid "The Truth That Leads to Eternal Life" that he had received years before.

form: Ano awaay ko toki ato 'icel ita mihamham to tao anca micada to pihamham no tao, wa misamaan kita to demak nga'?
translation: What might we do if having little time and energy limits our accepting or extending hospitality?

form: Pakalalokay ko Fangcalay Cudad kitanan patahekal to mihamhamay, mihaen o nganga'ay a misalof to kalala'ed ato tao, ano o 'adato o mamala nga'ay.
translation: To improve relationships, even with enemies, the Bible recommends hospitality.

form: Mahecaday, ano marariday kita midemak to ka'intehan no Kawas a demak, kalikien ita misalof a mifalic nga'.
translation: Similarly, we need to act with urgency in obeying the command to strip off habits that are contrary to God's personality.

form: Mankora toha saka nga'ayaw no mitosilay demak, midoedoan niyam ko holic, mitokel ano hacowaay mamafalic ko pakayraan.
translation: So in order to get the preaching work done, we obeyed the laws, hoping that things would change for the better.

form: Ano iraay ko no'adingoan a harateng i, wa misamaan ko hademak no mita hani?
translation: How will being spiritually-minded affect our life?

form: Ano sapi'acaw kita to so'linay kimad wa misadak to maanan sapi'aca aki?
translation: What things may be included in the price we have to pay for the truth?

form: Ano micoli ko salawina tisowanan midoko ci Yihofaan i, misamaan kiso mitafo to madimadi?
translation: How can you maintain your loyalty to Jehovah if your relatives oppose true worship?

form: Miki'okan ni Yihofa ko finawlan Ningra, ano misaali cangra i, o mamipadang cangranan.
translation: Jehovah gives us a basis for being convinced that he will help his people when they are in need.

form: O roma, ano mihai ci Yis a pasata, o mikotoday ci Yisan a tamdaw, wa miliyasto cingranan, sanay ko harateng nangra.
translation: If Jesus said that taxation was a necessary burden, he could lose the support of his followers.

form: Midemakay kako to miciwmongay to casi, mitafo a parakat i yofing, anca micada a militemoh to tayraay i Pitil a tamdaw, ano o manan ko silsil no salikaka, makahiyay kako micada.
translation: I wrapped magazines for mailing, processed subscriptions, and served as a receptionist; I did whatever I was asked to do.

form: Ano o ci Pawloto, maedeng miako'iday to sida'it ni Parnapas.
translation: On the other hand, Paul certainly would have appreciated Barnabas' kindness and compassion.

form: Ano midama kita to demak no Hongti Kitakit, wa milifok to maanan a sapalemed?
translation: How can we train our children and new ones to have a share?

form: Ano pasalaten no Wawa kamo i, o so'linayto mapasalat kamo.
translation: "If the Son sets you free, you will be truly free."

form: Ano cisasa ko kaemangay tamdaw to so'linay kimad, samanen no wama wina a padama cangranan?
translation: If a young person has doubts, how can parents provide assistance?

form: Ano mapakangolaw kita i, o misapoeneray capeling wa nga'ay padama kitaanan paka'met to tireng.
translation: Humility also helps us to show self-control when we are provoked.

form: Mamisa'icel kita rihaday ato salikaka, so'lin ano mapakararaw no tao, anca caka sadafdaf ko picada no tao, mamihaen kita to demak.
translation: We do everything in our power to maintain peace with our brothers, even when we feel that we have been misunderstood or treated unfairly.

form: Ano hatiraay i, licayen ko niyah: "Micongeday ko fa'inay takowan a midoko to Kawas han?
translation: If you face a similar situation, ask yourself: 'Is my spouse demanding that I stop worshipping my God?

form: Ano ma'odangay ko raramod, o makoracay a tamdaw nga'ayay misodod a miliyaw madadi'i to raramod, wa awaayto ko mihaian no Fangcalay Cudad a lalangian a malalikong.
translation: When he or she resumes sexual relations with the guilty mate, the grounds for obtaining a Scriptural divorce would be canceled.

form: Ano malahecito koni demak, edengan oya so'linay midoko ci Yihofaan a tamdaw ko mamaterek i sera.
translation: When this is accomplished, only true worshippers of God will be left on the cleansed earth.

form: So'linay i, ano caka paratoh to tamdaw, o awaay ko ngodo ato olah.
translation: In fact, not offering or responding to a greeting may be taken as unloving or as evidence of bad manners.

form: Ano misaka dademak kiso to Wa Samaan ko Ka'orip Noikor Hani?
translation: You might choose to use the tract What Is the Kingdom of God?

form: Mihaenay, ano cisasaay kiso toniya lihaf, keni'en ko sapipalahdaw a eca ka pasadak to mararaway a lihaf.
translation: If in doubt, hit the delete key, not the send button.

form: Mikitini toniya lalakaw mahapinangay ita, ano sapahecadaw to harateng ni Yihofa, cowa ko pisa'icel aca miliyas to pifiyor no tatiihay, wa minanamho tano harateng ni Yihofa a misimsim.
translation: As mentioned earlier, to think like Jehovah, we must do more than keep our minds free from corrupting influences.

form: Mihaenay, ano todongen ita ci Yis, nganga'ay padadotoc patahekal to olah.
translation: Yes, if we imitate Jesus, we will always act with love.

form: Ano malitemoh iso ko cecay Misawacayay Tamdaw ni Yihofa anca cowa pidoko to Kawas a tamdaw, o maanan ko kasasiromaan hani?
translation: What is unique about meeting other Witnesses?

form: Ano samisi ko kacipinang ita to pisalof ato faelohay a limasmas no likakawa i, nga'ay haratengen to samaanay ci Kristo mikayat to finawlan no Kawas isalakat.
translation: When we do not fully understand the reasons for some organizational changes, we do well to reflect on how Christ exercised his leadership in the past.

form: Ano pakaso'linen ko mararaway a lihaf wa mikidat to pakidemay a teloc.

form: Mahapinangayho ako, ano o samaanayto ko fanges no salikaka, mahecaday kitaanan, kamayan o salikaka ita cangra, o nganga'ay mikinafalah kita to 'orip saki cangraanan.
translation: And I have learned that a brother is a brother regardless of skin color, and he will die for you if need be.

form: Ano padama kita to wawa anca pacekiwan midemak toniya kalimelaan a demak i, haharatengen ko cecay a demak: Ciharatengay ko tamdaw malo Krisciyang, micada to ino' nga' nga'ay.
translation: As we assist our children and other Bible students to take the essential steps, we should bear in mind that genuine discipleship includes baptism.

form: "Ano icowa ko dafong anca odo' namo i, itira ko faloco' namo."
translation: "Where your treasure is, there your hearts will be also."

form: Kaemangho kako ato tatolo fafahiyan mipili'an to papafeli to hana ci Atawf Sitelean, ano mikimad cingra i, tayra pafeli to hana i cingranan.
translation: I was among four little girls chosen to present Adolf Hitler with flowers after he gave a speech one time.

form: Ano mitosil kita i, sasamaan mitodong to misapoeneray ni Pawlo hani?
translation: When preaching, how can we imitate Paul's exemplary humility?

form: Ano pakalalok kita to tamdaw i, sasinanoten ko maanan hani?
translation: What is essential if we want to build up others?

form: Ano caka paka'met to tireng, iraay ko maanan a teloc?
translation: What can result from a lack of self-control?

form: Ano padadotoc a mitosil itini pakidemay a saroero, papaira to manan nga'ayay a teloc?
translation: What positive results come from continuing to preach despite persecution?

form: Itiya, miceriday kako mitolon ato romadiw to radiw no Hongti Kitakita, miharateng ano pasalat wa misamaan a mitosil, rihadayay ko faloco' ako mihaen to demak.
translation: To maintain peace of heart during that time, I constantly prayed, sang Kingdom songs, and imagined how I would preach if I were free again.

form: Ano misaaretengan iso ko pidoko ci Yihofaan a demak, ano patireng to patosokan i miharateng to pinengneng ni Yihofa, mihaen o mamasalo ko faloco'.
translation: You too will enjoy a truly satisfying life if you keep service to Jehovah to the fore and set goals with him in mind.

form: Ano caho ka picada to ino'i, wa awa ko 'inorong ci Yihofaan han?
translation: Does delaying baptism make one less accountable to Jehovah?

form: Oniya lalakaw wa padama kitaanan mihapinang, so'lin matongalay ko cariraw, sapalifet, ato roray no mita, ano ti'eren ita ci Yihofa wa milifok to sapalifon ato salidong no Kawas.
translation: This article helps us to see that even if worries, trials, and pain increase, ultimately our trust in God will be rewarded with deliverance.

form: Ano caka talipa'elal kita, wa marefong i talakal, mikasimaan misaka dademak to kalimelaan a pasalat.
translation: How easy it is to fall prey to these ploys and to misuse our freedom!

form: Mihaen to demak, ano o micadaay to sapadang anca mipadangay tamdaw, nganga'ay mala widang ni Yihofa.
translation: Thus, Jehovah's friendship is being freely extended to both the givers and the receivers.

form: Ano itira kami i Tuplin i, itiniay i loma' no fafahiyan salikaka ci Ma Rutlan milafin, pinaayto miheca midoko to Kawas a madimadiay Krisciyang cingra.
translation: One place where pioneers could always stay in Dublin was at the home of Ma Rutland, a longtime faithful sister.

form: Ano caka olah ko matosilan i, wa samaan kita palahad to sini'adaay a faloco' hani?

form: Pakayni mapasimalay Krisciyang i, ano patikol ma'orip tayra i kakarayan i, wa so'li'lin a paka'araw to Kawas cangra.
translation: Of course, resurrected anointed ones will in a literal sense see Jehovah when they receive their heavenly reward.

form: Ano patahekal kita to sini'adaay, papaira to manan a epoc?

form: Ano cowaho patafang to tireng a micada to ino' kiso, haratengen hano kalimlaan mihaen to demak.

form: Latekay, o sowal ato demak no salikaka pakararaway kitanan, ano kita to pakararaway cangranan.

form: Kawraan, ano pakayniay katoled iso a sawad saan mihodop ci Yihofaan, wa kahenay mahapinang iso, edengan o salikaka i kasakopang ato Krisciyang a wama wina iso ko so'linay a maolah tisowanan.
translation: But if you allow frustration to make you give up serving Jehovah, you would soon discover that no one else cares for you more genuinely than your God-fearing parents and your congregation.

form: Ano tahalifa cangra to pasangaray i, wa misatapang miharateng to araaw no tamdaw ma'orip, caayho ka harateng nangra konini i sa'ayaw.

form: Latek ano mafalic ko demak, anca irato ko faelohay fana', mamafalic ko nisa'osian.

form: Kinacecayay, o cecay Misawacayay Tamdaw ni Yihofa pasowalay ci Alonan, pakakadepen ko sepat no Hipray a ngangan no Kawas, nga'ayay 'osien to "Yihofa".
translation: He was thrilled when a Witness showed him that by combining vowel points with the four Hebrew consonants of God's name, it could be pronounced "Jehovah."

form: Sasamaan ko demak no malohemay malitengay wa masongila'a madimokos ko siri no Kawas?
translation: What fine qualities will help elders to be effective shepherds of God's flock?

form: O cecay kaemangay fa'inayan salikaka ci Enli, miliyasay ko salawina ningra to likakawa no Kawas, cowa ka hatini aca, oya malo malohemay malitengay a wama ningra cowa to pihodop ci Yihofaan, tada masomaday ci Enli tonini.
translation: Henri, a young brother, was greatly distressed when his close relatives, including his father, who had been a respected elder, left the truth.

form: Hongti Kitakit no Kawas.
translation: Proclaiming the Kingdom of God.

form: O sowal no Kawas padamaay ci Yopuan mifalic to kapinengneng ningra.
translation: This helped Job regain the proper perspective.

form: Mananamay nangra ci Apraham, Yopu, aci Taniil, pakaso'linay to papatikolen no Kawas pa'orip ko mapatayay noikor.
translation: And they learn that Abraham, Job, and Daniel were confident that in the future the dead would live again.

form: Anini, o roma tamdaw mahaenay nisowalan ni Solomon, o hafay no niyah ko miti'eran ao cowa ko Kawas.
translation: Likely you can think of people who trust in their wealth rather than in God.

form: Yihofa Kawas 'icel no mita,
translation: Jehovah, our Rock, Our strength and our might,

form: So'lin na mararaway kako, kawra cowa ka toled a makesem kako, miharatengan koniya sifana' padotoc a matayal i Kawas.
translation: But I have experienced that instead of letting the hands drop, it is best to learn a lesson from a mistake and remember that lesson as you move on.

form: Itiya, itiniay i Yirusalim cingra pasayra i "kakerikeridan no finawlan ato mato'asay, ato pasifana'ay to rikec a tamdaw," no Yutaya a pasowal: 'Oya Nacali tamdaw ci Yis Kristo, na mipacekan namo i hecek, patikolanto no Kawas pa'orip cingra nai patay.'
translation: He spoke of "Jesus Christ the Nazarene, whom you executed on a stake but whom God raised up from the dead."

form: Masalofto mihongyak tora asier ikor, ora nisowalan a sapalemed i saka 12 tangasa 14 sinael, oyaanto moecelay tamdaw ko mitoro'an, cangra mingitangitay to pilidong no Kawas, mitokel to sapiliyasaw to pikari'ang no tatiihay tamdaw saka 11 sinael.
translation: The use of "then" in verse 12 means that the blessings that follow in verses 12 to 14 are understood as applying to the righteous, those who ask to be 'rescued and saved' from the wicked verse 11.

form: O sowal ni Yis paihkalay to, o limasmas no raramod mikitiniay i Kawas, o tahada'ocay ko kalala'ed no raramod.
translation: Jesus thus agreed that marriage is of divine origin and stressed its permanence.

form: Ingiden ita ko Kawas, mingitangit to sapadama Ningra.
translation: Rather, we must approach Jehovah, begging for his help.

form: So'li'lin, o romaroma nangra cato ka adihay ko demak saki Kawas, kawra nga'ayay patahekal to timolo cangra, padama to kasakopang.
translation: Some may not be able to do as much as they once did in God's service, but they can still show courage and go to work.

form: Salakat, o limasmas no Kawas to raramod i Itin, cecay ko fa'inay cecay ko fafahi, oniya "tatosaay" wa tahada'oc a malacafay.
translation: The standard set in that Edenic marriage was monogamy, "the two" being joined together in a lasting union.

form: Nga'ay kita midoko to misanga'ay kitanan a Kawas, mitodong to capeling Ningra, halo picangacang to sadipot ningra, tada ta'angayay sakaliko konini!
translation: What a privilege to worship a God in whose image we are made, whose qualities we can imitate, and in whom we can take refuge!

form: O sapafeli no Kawas a pasalat padamaay kitanan miliyas to pipalit no raraw ato patay, pahecaden ita ci Pawloan, cowa ko sasaloya'en ko sapafeli no Kawas a pasalat.
translation: Following Paul's example, we too should never take for granted that Jehovah liberated us from the bondage of sin and of death.

form: Cipinang toniya demak padamaay cingraanan misa'osi to faloco' mitafo to madimadi i Kawas, makahi a patado kitaanan a kinafalah to 'orip.
translation: This knowledge strengthened his decision to maintain his faithful, self-sacrificing course without wavering.

form: So'li'lin masasi romaay ko pinangan ni Pawlo aci Parnapas, kawra makakapotayho a matayal saki Kawas.
translation: Despite the different personalities of Paul and Barnabas, they had been able to serve together before that event.

form: Cowa picangacang ci Pawlo to pasalat pasayra i milikecay, misa'icelay ato romaroma Krisciyang padama to tamdaw mitapal to pafeliay to pasalat a Kawas.
translation: Rather than looking to any human ruler or agency for freedom, Paul and his fellow Christians worked hard to help others learn the good news of God's Kingdom and the incomparable value of the ransom sacrifice of Christ Jesus.

form: Milicayay ci Matiyas: "O cima ko Kawas?

form: Pa'ayawan ni Yis ko nisawawaan: "O saki Kawas a tayal ita konini, o sasaan cangra to nipipatay nangra i tamowanan."

form: Sarocoden miti'er ko Kawas,

form: O Kawas niyam ci Yihofa sanay a kitakit tada malemeday!

form: Mikitini i nalifetan no 'alomanay ma'araway ita, tada sini'adaay to tamdaw ko Kawas.

translation: Psalm 147 repeatedly encourages God's people to praise Jehovah.

form: Hano nganga'ay kita mahemek a mihodop to lipahakay a Kawas hani?
translation: Why are we happy to serve "the happy God"?

form: Tikolen ni Cilisi miharateng koya romi'ad i, sanay ko sowal: "Marariday kako pasowal ci Matiyasan, tada maolahay kami tisowanan, fanekfekay patado cingranan mitolon to Kawas, micangacang ci Yihofaan padama cingranan cipinang to so'linay kimad."
translation: Looking back, Gillis says: "I often told Mattias that our deep love for him moved his mother and me to pray even more intensely that Jehovah would help him to understand."

form: Kalimelaan i, minanam to samaan pa'dil to pafeliay to pasalat a Kawas ci Yihofa.
translation: Above all, we will learn how to honor Jehovah, the God of true freedom.

form: Oni tosa lalakaw papadama kitanan cipinang to satadamaanay noka pikowan ni Yihofa, to hakowaay ko nika masaka limlaan, ato samaanen ita midopo ko satadamaanay noka pikowan no Kawas.
translation: These articles will help us to appreciate the importance of Jehovah's sovereignty and to understand how we can uphold it.

form: O sapafeli no Kawas a rihaday, samaan padama kitaanan misi'ayaw to kafalic no pakayraane?

form: Saka 2, simsimen miharateng, samaanen mitodong ko ta'arawan no Kawas, ato mamisamaan to demak nga' ira ko nga'ayay minaro'an.
translation: Second, consider how you can imitate God's example and how your doing so is truly beneficial.

form: Yihofa a Kawas,

translation: Now they are prouder than ever to be part of God's organization."

form: O sarikec no Kawas pairaay to maanan a sadama kitaanan hani?

translation: All of them professed to worship Jehovah, but their devotion to him was far from exclusive.

form: Kapah tamdaw, salimlaen ko sapafeli no Kawas kisowanan a pasalat.
translation: Young ones, cherish the freedom God has given you.

form: O olah to Kawas mikowaday to romaroma tamdaw makahi mifalah to sakacihafayaw, misarocod to faloco' a midoko ci Yihofaan.
translation: Love of God has moved some to give up potentially lucrative careers to serve Jehovah more fully.

form: Kawra o sapalemed no Kawas, wa nga'ay ko pakayraan.
translation: But that would change as God blessed them.

form: Pairaen ko matatodongay a harateng, maolah to Kawas ato maolah to tao nga', kodait a midemak to patorodan no Kawas a demak.
translation: We can endure in this work only if we have the right motivation, love for God and love for our neighbor.

form: Ilaenoay lalakaw mamilengo, misamaan kita misanga'ay a kalasaka dademak to pasalat, honga' tahada'oc a pa'odingar toya pasalatay kitaanan a Kawas Yihofa.
translation: The following article will consider how we can wisely use the freedom we now have, so that we can honor Jehovah, the God of true freedom, forever.

form: O maanan ko kasasiromaan no mihodopay to Kawas a tamdaw ato cowa pihodop to Kawas a tamdaw hani?
translation: What clear distinction must exist between those who serve Jehovah and those who do not?

form: Misamaanay hano pakaso'lin kita, ci'icelay ko Sowal no Kawas?
translation: Why can there be no doubt that God's Word exerts power?

form: Mafana' toninian, papa'icel to nika paso'lin ita to Kawas, mihadidi a mitala Cingranan mifohat to kasadakan lalan.
translation: This will strengthen our trust in him as we wait patiently for him to act in our behalf.

form: Pasowalan no Paino'ay a Yohani cangra: "Maedeng ko Kawas a misanga' to maloteloc ni Apraham" tonini a fakelokeloh.
translation: But John the Baptist told them: "God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones."

form: O papala'osien no Kawas ko miki'okan Ningra, hano mamihinom to faloco' ita aki?

form: O romasa i, pasifana'an kita, too manan ko sanga'ayay a noka'orip, mihaenay ciharateng ko Kawas kitanan.

form: Pa'ayaway ko 'Olic 40:8 maolahay ci Yis to sarikec no Kawas, sanay ko sowal: "Kawasaw ako, tada maolah kako a midoedo to nafaloco'an Iso.

form: Nolatekay, finawlan no Kawas pakayniay i mikiriwi'ay a araaw ko pipatafang.

form: Nawhani mahaento a makari'ang ko i'ayaway namo a pali'ayaway to sowal no Kawas a tamdaw.
translation: Rejoice and be overjoyed, since your reward is great in the heavens, for in that way they persecuted the prophets prior to you."

form: Mafana'ay ko Kawas to pisadak aca ni Hapakuk to nano roray ato somad no niyah.

form: Sadaken ko tinakoan, misamaanay kalasaka dademak ko roma salikaka to dafong no hekal, paihekal to madimadi no niyah to Kawas.
translation: Give examples of how some are showing faithfulness in their use of unrighteous riches.

form: Ikorto i, songila'en a misahalaka ko noka'orip iso, palipahak to faloco' no Kawas.
translation: Then plan to do what is pleasing to him.

form: O piratoh paihekalay to kaciharateng ato pipakahemek ita to roma tamdaw, hanaca micowatay to makelecay i kalala'ed no sikawdan no Kawas, mitongal to kalawidang no salikaka.
translation: Yes, greetings that express genuine personal interest and commendation fortify friendships and unite loyal servants of God.

form: Paihekalay koni to mangataayto mikowan ko Hongti Kitakit no Kawas, kakalikito mapalemed koni cikiw.

form: Samaan ko demak ita nga' "cipinang" to sapakahemek to faloco' ni Yihofa a pakayraan?

form: Caho ka masanga' ci Atam aci Ifa i, patahekalayto ci Yihofa to olah i tamdamdaw.

form: Miki'okan ni Yihofa ci Mosi, wa mitengil ko malohemay malitengay no Israil to sowal ningra.
translation: He also promised: The elders of Israel "will certainly listen to your voice."

form: Aniniho minanam to harateng ni Yihofa hano o masaka limlaan.
translation: Why is it important to learn Jehovah's thinking on matters now?

form: Taneng 18:22 sanay: "O cifafahiyay to citanengay a fafahi i, awaay ko tolas a malemed, mahapinang ko sini'ada ni Yihofa a palemed i cangraan."

form: Haratengen ita oha mamasemer ato papalifon ci Yihofa to madimadiay a sikawdan Ningra, hanaca tatano kafahka'an ita a pakayraan a palifon kitaanan.
translation: Keep close in mind that Jehovah always gives recognition to his faithful servants and that he often rewards them in unexpected ways.

form: Tengilen ita ko limo'ot, wa nga'ay paso'lin tatano sida'itay ko sapicada ni Yihofa kitaanan.

form: O tamdaw ni Yihofa, Ka tala'ayaw!

form: Pakaynian ni Yihofa i masamaanay pakayraan mihinom kita?

form: Mihaenay paifaloco'en ita ko saki'ok ni Yihofa, hamaan papi'afasen ko kalo demak to halifon iso!

form: Masakalimlaan i, wa tahada'oc maharateng ni Yihofa kiso.

form: O cima ko kalimlaan ni Yihofa a finawlan nohatini hani?

form: Mihaenay, saalien no wama wina ci Yihofa to sakayat, tada kalimelaan.
translation: How important, then, that Christian parents look to Jehovah for guidance.

form: Saka tosa lalakaw patalipa'elalay kitanan samaan miliyas to mararaway waywayan, ho eca ka lahedaw ko miki'okan ni Yihofa a sapalifon.

form: Pakayni to 'icel ni Yihofa a miadah to doka' no faloco', o manan ko sowal no 'Olic?

translation: Compare it with the countless man-made laws that men have been forced to learn and obey.

form: Tikoren a minengneng ko noka'orip ako, mahapinangay ako to samaanay palemed ci Yihofa to mitosilay demak i Aielan!

form: Palimo'otan ni Yihofa ko kapah tamdaw misamaan to demak?

form: Patireng to no'adingoan a patosokan wa samaan milingat to kalala'ed iso aci Yihofa hani?

form: Misamaan to demak kita honga' milifok to sida'it ato sasodod ni Yihofa hani?

form: Toni pinamiheca matayal saki ci Yihofaan, mananamay ako sapitafoaw to madimadiay kalimelaan ko kinafalahay, Kawra o sapafeli ni Yihofa a rihaday awaay ko pakafiloay.
translation: My years of service to Jehovah have taught me that keeping integrity comes at a cost but the inner peace that Jehovah gives in return is a treasure of surpassing value.

form: Cowa ko cipinang aca to so'linay kimad, kalimelaan i patirengay to nga'ayay kala widang ako aci Yihofa."

form: Ikorto, palidlid sa macakat kita i no'adingoan, matongalay ko kacipinang to harateng ni Yihofa, cipinang to o manan ko kaolahan Ningra, o manan ko kapili'an Ningra, ato pinengneng Ningra to demak.

form: Ci Yihofa cowa ko nika sini'ada aca to tamdaw, pasifana'ayho to tamdaw Ningra, papipatahekal to sini'adaay a capeling.

form: Sanay cingra: "Paso'linay kako to dadipoten ni Yihofa kako!"

translation: Timothy was a disciple who made the truth his own at a young age.

form: Tayra kami i dimeng i, mahemekay kako iraay ko timoloay ato maolahay ci Yihofaan a fafahi.
translation: As we were escorted to the police station, I reflected on how fortunate I was to have such a bold and spiritual wife.

form: Sowal ni Atewa: "Misarocoday ko faloco' noniya mararamoday patafang to niyah ci Yihofaan, nga'ayay ko kacakat i no'adingoan."
translation: He said: "Both husband and wife are fully consecrated and are showing wonderful progress."

form: Iraay ko toki ni Kain midopo ci Yihofaan, kawra samaanay ko demak ningra hani?
translation: Given the opportunity to be on Jehovah's side, what did Cain do?

form: Malecad ci Yihofaan aci Yisan Makelec a Malacecay
translation: May We All Be One as Jehovah and Jesus Are One

form: Saka dademakayho ci Satan to pakidemay sapalak pacieci kitaanan ecato ka madimadi ci Yihofaan.
translation: In addition to offering bait, Satan tries to bully us into compromising our loyalty to Jehovah.

form: So'li'lin a mafana' kita ci Yihofaan ato palinian Ningra, wa mipili' to samaanay a widang ato lawla?
translation: How does accurate knowledge of Jehovah and of his standards help us in choosing good associates and wholesome entertainment?

form: Kawra, matatodongay ko demak ni Mosi, samanen mihalamhamay cingra ci Yihofaan, misongila' a midoedo to sakayat.
translation: On that occasion, Moses reacted correctly by looking to Jehovah and then carefully following his direction.

form: Hano pahapinangen ita ko tao to misacecayay kita maolah ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: Why should it be obvious to others that we are exclusively devoted to Jehovah?

form: Hano mafana' kita o mamicada to ino' a tamdaw, maherekayto a miemin patafang to tireng ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: Why is it reasonable to conclude that individuals who present themselves for baptism have already made an unreserved dedication to Jehovah?

form: Misamaanay hano mamicerid kiso miako'id ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: Why should you always give thanks to Jehovah?

form: O tawki no paro no loma' ato malohemay malitengay misamaan a mitodong ci Yihofaan?
translation: How can elders and family heads imitate Jehovah?

form: Sapihaenaw to demak so'li'lin a mafana' ci Yihofaan nga'.
translation: The key is to have accurate knowledge of him.

form: O limasmas noni pilimekan niyaro', hano matongal ko kafana' ita ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: How can the arrangement of the cities of refuge help us to understand Jehovah better?

form: Tada miako'iday kami ci Yihofaan aci Yisan padotoc pafeli to dipayal tamiyanan!
translation: How thankful we are to be blessed with lasting inner peace!

form: Mihodop ci Yihofaan tada pakahemekay kitaanan.
translation: Jesus said to his disciples: "Take my yoke upon you."

form: Tada maketeray cangra, ngaliwngiwayho ci Mosian, mansa pasayra ci Mosi ci Yihofaan a micangacang: "Samaanen ako konini a finawlan?
translation: They began to murmur against Moses, and the situation became so serious that Moses cried out to Jehovah: "What should I do with this people?

form: Hano pakafana'en ko tao to o madimadiay ci Yihofaan kita hani?
translation: Why should it be obvious to others that we are devoted to Jehovah exclusively?

form: Ano maolahay kita ci Yihofaan ato salikaka i, o mamikiemel a eca pakihater han mirepat ko rihaday no tamdaw no Kawas.
translation: If we love Jehovah and our brothers, we will do all we can to keep personal differences from disturbing or diminishing the peace of God's people.

form: Ano miliyas ko paro no loma' ci Yihofaan i, o manan ko papadama tisowanan miremo to somad?
translation: What can help you to cope if a family member leaves Jehovah?

form: Ci Stifen, naitiniay i Tenmak, sanay: "To romi'ami'ad, mitosil to cowaho pakatengil ci Yihofaan tamdaw, so'linay kako pa'odingar to ngangan ni Yihofa."
translation: Steffen, who is from Denmark, said: "Every day, I was able to preach to people who had never heard about Jehovah.

form: Ano malacafay kiso to tao i, mitodongay ci Yihofaan han?
translation: Do you imitate Jehovah when dealing with others?

form: Hatiraay, halamham ci Yihofaan macapiday ko maanan hani?
translation: What is involved in looking to Jehovah?

form: Makalimay kiso mitongal to tayal ci Yihofaan han?
translation: Would you like to work with Jehovah more fully?

form: Oniya madimadiay tamdaw miliyasay to misafelitay a tamdaw, paihkal to kalacafayay ko niyah ci Yihofaan.
translation: These loyal ones were not just taking sides with Jehovah but were at the same time separating themselves from the wrongdoers.

form: Ci Asiperatio padotocay madimadi ci Yihofaan, ta'angayay ko nika padama to kasakopang.
translation: As we might expect, Esperandio continues to serve Jehovah faithfully and to be a blessing to his congregation.

form: Wa samaan ko demak ita nga' misamacay ko minengnengan ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: What is involved in fixing our eyes on Jehovah?

form: Ano malacafay kita ci Yihofaan a matayal to romi'ami'ad, wa malifok ko maanan a sapalemed hani?
translation: What do you stand to gain by working with Jehovah each day?

form: Samaanay ci Mosi aci Aron paihkal to midopoay ci Yihofaan ko niyah hani?
translation: How did Moses and Aaron show that they were firmly on Jehovah's side?

form: Nohatini, nga'ayayto kako mifowah to faloco' ci Yihofaan."
translation: Now, I feel that I can approach Jehovah without anything being in the way."

form: Hato misamacayay ci Mosi to harateng no niyah, mapawanto a pa'dil ci Yihofaan hokira?
translation: Was Moses thinking mainly of his own feelings instead of how he could glorify Jehovah?

form: Misamanay hano 'o misa'adaay ci Yihofaan, awaay ko taneng' hani?
translation: Why is there "no wisdom... in opposition to Jehovah"?

form: Tanektek kiso a mihodop ci Yihofaan, pakalalokay to 'alomanay tamdaw, ano o adihayay ko milifetan a mitosilay micadaay to sapakalalok.
translation: * Your steadfastness in serving Jehovah is a source of encouragement for many, even for experienced fellow believers.

form: MIDOKO KITA ci Yihofaan, mitokelay to sapilifokaw to olah Ningra, cowa ka hatira han?
translation: WE SERVE Jehovah and want his favor, do we not?

form: Hano ciharateng kiso to sapasayraaw ci Yihofaan a mikilim to sadipot hani?
translation: Why do you want to take refuge in Jehovah?

form: Naitiniay i Frans a Stifani, sanay ko sowal: "Mikitini toni mikiriwi'ay demak mananamay niyam, cowa ko serangawan anca sasowalen ko palacecayay tamiyanan, ao nika olah niyam ci Yihofaan."
translation: Stéphanie from France added: "The special campaign taught us that what unites us is not the culture or language but the love for Jehovah that we have in common."

form: Paihkalay cangra to madimadi ci Yihofaan ato likakawa Ningra.
translation: They have shown loyalty to Jehovah and to his organization!

form: Midimokos to paro no loma' hano mahecaday o malacafayay ci Yihofaan a matayal hani?
translation: Why can it be said that everyone who cares for his family is cooperating with God?

form: Pakayni palahad to wawa, mitengil a mihakelong ci Yihofaan ko wama wina, hano masaka limelaan hani?
translation: How important is parental example in training children?

form: Ano tano niyah a pakayraan ko pisaysay to demak eca ka halamham ci Yihofaan, mihaen o cowato kangodo ci Yihofaan.
translation: To do otherwise and avenge ourselves in some way would be tantamount to disrespecting Jehovah.

form: Patafang kita to tireng ci Yihofaan micada to ino', paihkalay to maanan?
translation: What are some of the things we accomplish through dedication and baptism?

form: Misodod kita to pakararaway kitaanan a tamdaw, paihekalay to miako'iday kita ci Yihofaan, pakayni i sapatefoc ni Kristo a misodod to raraw no mita.
translation: When we forgive those who have offended us, we show that we appreciate the forgiveness of our own sins made possible by Christ's ransom sacrifice.

form: Ano padotoc kita halamham ci Yihofaan, cato ka pakayni i waywayan no tao a maketer, hato mapalak ko kalala'ed no niyah aci Yihofa.
translation: If we keep our figurative eyes focused on Jehovah, we will not allow the actions of others to embitter us or damage our relationship with him.

form: Harateng iso, sapadotocaw mahemek a mihodop ci Yihofaan, cowa ko madoloay hokira?
translation: Do you at times find it hard to maintain your joy in Jehovah's service?

form: Misarocod kita a mitosil, micowat to kakelec, padotoc a mikecol, wa nga'ay pa'dil ci Yihofaan.
translation: The increase we observe, the unity we enjoy, and the watchful attitude that we strive to maintain all contribute to our bringing glory to Jehovah.

form: Mahemekay kita patafang to sapatelong ci Yihofaan, samanen maolahay ato miako'iday kita Cingranan.
translation: We give to Jehovah because of our love and appreciation for him.

form: Patafang to dafong ci Yihofaan, milingatay to pidoko Cingranan.
translation: Giving is also an expression of our worship of Jehovah.

form: Miako'iday kita ci Yihofaan nga'ay malo finawlan Ningra kita.
translation: Surely we are eager to show our appreciation to Jehovah for the honor of being his people.

form: O Krisciyang alatek pakayni to maanan a lalangian, malahdaw ko kalawidang ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: What could cause us to lose our relationship with Jehovah?

form: O malinahay tayra i Tureky a roma kitakit a salikaka, to romi'ami'ad malitemohay ko cowaho pakatengil ci Yihofaan a tamdaw.
translation: Every day, need-greaters who moved to Turkey meet people who have never heard about Jehovah.

form: Roma i, ano saka madimadiaw kita ci Yihofaan, misi'ayaw to macalohay no paisingay a demak, wa isalakat midotim to harateng ni Yihofa.
translation: Giving advance thought to the need to remain loyal can also prove helpful in the event of a medical emergency.

form: Midofdof ci Yihofaan so'lina mamikinafalah to maanan, saikor o mamalifok ko ta'angayay hemek.
translation: That is so even if his requirements involve our making some sacrifices.

form: Mihaen a tosa ko palinian o milipalaway to wama wina, kasakopang, milipalawayho ci Yihofaan.
translation: They may use bad language, wear immodest clothes, listen to debased music, abuse alcohol or drugs, date secretly, and worse.

form: Saka cecay hahekalan a Krisciyang patirengay to ta'arawan, mapolong a romadiw pahemek ci Yihofaan.
translation: First-century Christians set a pattern of praising God together in song.

form: O ciraramoday Krisciyang ano maolahay ci Yihofaan tatodongen Cingra.
translation: Accordingly, married couples who love Jehovah's ways imitate him.

form: Ano sakacakataw i pihodop ci Yihofaan, makahi kiso micada to adihayay a sapahatatanam han?
translation: Do you desire to receive further training so as to be better equipped to carry out your sacred service?

form: Sasamaan kita miremo to ci'angiay, mahemek a romadiw pakahemek ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: How can we overcome the fear of using our voice to sing praises to Jehovah?

form: Samaanay kita padama cangranan mafana' ci Yihofaan ato araaw Ningra hani?
translation: What can you do to help such ones come to know Jehovah and his purpose?

form: Ano misi'ayaw kita to pasangaray a sapalifet i noka'orip i, sasamaan misamacay ko minengnengan ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: And how can we make sure that our eyes remain fixed on him as we face life's complex challenges?

form: O micadaayto kiso to ino'a kaemangay, anca sapicadaaw to ino'a tamdaw, ano sapitongalaw to kalawidang ci Yihofaan, wa misamaan kiso to demak hani?
translation: Baptized young ones and those who are contemplating baptism, how can you strengthen your relationship with Jehovah?

form: So'lin mapaci'ci malaliyas to fafahi ato wawa, kawra maharateng to padotocay madimadiay kako aci Mariya ci Yihofaan, masayaray ko faloco' ako.
translation: Although my wife and daughters were far away, I drew comfort from knowing that Maria and I had remained loyal to Jehovah.

form: Ano sakacaaw ka palak no kalawidang ci Yihofaan i, wa samaan ko hademak ita hani?
translation: What course of action is vital if we are to protect our special friendship with Jehovah?

form: Ci Filip aci Mari padotoc a misamacay mihodop ci Yihofaan, malifokay nangra ko sapafeli ni Yihofa a sapalemed.
translation: In response to their efforts to maintain a spiritual outlook on their situation, Jehovah blessed Philip and Mary in many ways.

form: Ci Mosi aci Aron samaanay paihkal to midopoay ko niyah ci Yihofaan?
translation: How did Moses and Aaron seize opportunities to show that they were on Jehovah's side?

form: O cecacecay midokoay to Kawas a tamdaw, makalimay cangra pakayni ci Yihofaan a ci'icel, tanoktok a mihodop ci Yihofa.
translation: All of us desire to be made strong by Jehovah and to remain firm in our worship.

form: Mafiyoray no waywayan no tao ci Mosi, telocto cowa ka padotoc mihalamham ci Yihofaan.
translation: Moses allowed the actions of others to distract him from keeping his eyes fixed on Jehovah.

form: Samaan kita miliyas to pakayni i raraw no tao a mapalak ko kalala'ed ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: How can we avoid damaging our relationship with Jehovah even though we may be dealing with the mistakes of others?

form: Tada mahemekay ci Aan mipadang ci Paulaan padadotoc a midoko ci Yihofaan.
translation: Ann too is happy, for she has been like a spiritual mother to Paula.

form: Tahiraay i patay ko kamadimadi no wama wina ako a mihodop ci Yihofaan, mitokelay kako militemoh cangranan i faelohay hekal.
translation: My parents both died faithful to Jehovah, and I look forward to welcoming them back in a much better world.

form: Ikor, misafelitay ci Yihofaan ko Israil tamdaw, cowato pidama to matatodongay a pihakelongan.
translation: Over time, most Israelites claiming to serve Jehovah turned their backs on him and on true worship.

form: Ci Solomon midemakay to maanan a pakararaway ci Yihofaan a demak hani?
translation: To what extreme did Solomon offend Jehovah?

form: O micawma'an iso a tamdaw wa samaan ko pilingat to kalawidang iso aci Yihofaan?
translation: What effect are your associates having on your relationship with Jehovah?

form: Ano midoko kiso ci Yihofaan wa ira ko 'alomanay nga'ayay a widang, naitiniay icowacowa pala cangra, o roma cowaho ka so'araw iso!
translation: It is no exaggeration to say that as a worshipper of Jehovah, you have the very best kind of friends, and they are all around the world.

form: O kapah no kasakopang misa'icel pakahemek ci Yihofaan, wa nga'ay milifok to haepoc no niyah.
translation: Young people in the congregation benefit themselves if they focus on pleasing Jehovah.

form: Wa nga'ay kita misamaan mitodong ci Yihofaan, miliyas to waywayan no pasifana'ay to Rikec ato Farisay tamdaw hani?
translation: How can we avoid the attitude of the scribes and Pharisees and imitate Jehovah?

form: Malecaday toya mitiliday to 'Olic a tamdaw kita, adihayay ko lalangian milekal "pahemek ci Yihofaan" halo pakalalok to romaroma tamdaw pakahemek i Cingranan!
translation: Like the writer of Psalm 147, do you not have many good reasons to cry out "Praise Jah!"

form: Ano samanayto ko tatodong ni Mosi, ora sowal ningra paihkalay to cowa ka ngodo ko niyah ci Yihofaan, samanen cowa panokayen ningra ci Yihofaan koniya sapidemak to kafahka'an a 'icel.
translation: Those words indicated a gross lack of respect for Jehovah as the true Source of that miracle.

form: Onini lalakaw wa milengo to samaanay hano patafang kita to kalimelaan a dafong a pa'odingar ci Yihofaan, ato mihaen ko demak ita wa milifok to manan sapalemed.
translation: This article will consider why and how we benefit from honoring Jehovah with our valuable things.

form: So'lin wa awa ko tolas no toki ita noikor, pakayniay ci Yihofaan a sifana' cowa ko mamaemin ita a minanam.
translation: Even with an eternity of time, we can always learn more about Jehovah.

form: 'Alomanay kapah i kasakopang pakaremoay to pasangaray, misarocod to faloco' mihodop ci Yihofaan, citodongay to papakahemeken no mita.
translation: Young people in the congregation deserve warm commendation for the way they meet these challenges and for being determined to focus their lives on serving Jehovah.

form: Iraay ko samaanay a hrateng ni Tafiti ci Yihofaan hani?
translation: How did David feel toward Jehovah?

form: Mahaen o masowalay i fafekang a tinakoan, ano misa'icel kita a midemak, ira ko pakaso'lin no faloco' mitala ci Yihofaan, wa nga'ayto kita mitafo to rihadayay faloco'.
translation: As these examples show, if we make the best of our circumstances and wait confidently on Jehovah, we will maintain our inner peace.

form: Kaemangho ci Yis milifetayto to patay no salawina.
translation: In his younger years, Jesus no doubt had to deal with the deaths of family members and acquaintances.

form: Pakayni to noka'orip no kaemanganho ni Yis, o matiliday ni Matay aci Luka hano caka hahecad?
translation: Why do Matthew's and Luke's accounts differ as to Jesus' early life?

form: Somowalay ci Yis to cecay tinakoan, milengo to cecay sida'itay a Samariya tamdaw samanay paihkal to adayayay.
translation: Jesus' illustration of the neighborly Samaritan vividly portrays what it means to show mercy.

form: Mihaenay, palahad kita to harateng ni Yis ato waywayan, tada o kalimelaan.
translation: For these reasons, it becomes clear how important it is to learn to think as Jesus does.

form: Sanay kora sinael: "Nengneng sa ci Yis to finawlan i, saadayay sa cingra, nawhani marawraw cangra a matiya o malafelay a siri to awaay ko pakaenay."
translation: That verse says: "On seeing the crowds, Jesus felt pity for them, because they were skinned and thrown about like sheep without a shepherd."

form: Nikawrira, cowa ka ciharateng ci Yosif, mihaen to tireng ni Yis.
translation: But that is not what Joseph had in mind for Jesus.

form: Kalimelaan i padamaan ningra ko 'alomanay, cipinang to mala'osiay ko piliyaw ni Yis ma'orip to 'Olic 16:10.
translation: More to the point, the people acknowledged that Psalm 16:10 was fulfilled when Jesus was resurrected from the dead.

form: Samaanay ci Yis misi'ayaw to misakakinihay?
translation: How did Jesus deal with prejudice?

form: Pakayni i matatodongay a pirikec ato ciepocay a pasifana', mikitini ta'arawan ni Yis mananamay ita ko maanan?
translation: What are some lessons about appropriate discipline and effective teaching that we can learn from Jesus?

form: O roma sapicowat to kalacecay a pakayraan i, dotimen ko tatodong no tahapinangan a dafong i Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Sa'opo.
translation: A second way we can promote unity is by reflecting on the meaning of the emblems used at the Memorial.

form: Iraayho ko maanan a wacay paihkal to sowal ni Yis i, "so'linen ako pasowal kiso anini" hani?
translation: What supports our understanding of what Jesus said?

form: 'Olic 118:22, iraay ko maanan kalaliting to piliyaw ni Yis a ma'orip?
translation: How did Psalm 118:22 point to Jesus' resurrection?

form: Pakayni i raramod pasowalay ci Yis to maanan a limo'ot hani?
translation: What important advice about marriage did Jesus give?

form: Isaka 2017 miheca, oni tolo a naniyaro'an, makalitosaay ko tamdaw, mirienangay to Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Sa'opo, ora mirienangay tosaay tingroh ko ka'aloman to mitosilay salikaka.
translation: As a result, in 2017, these three towns had a combined Memorial attendance of almost double the number of publishers, or half the entire population.

form: Misamaanay hano ira ko hatiniay a harateng ni Yis hani?
translation: b. Why did Jesus respond in that way?

form: Sanay ko ca'of ni Yis: 'Cowa ko noni hekal ko Hongti Kitakit ako.'
translation: Jesus answered: "My Kingdom is no part of this world."

form: Iraay ko timolo iso mihayi to o hongti iso ci Yis han?
translation: Do you have the courage to acknowledge Jesus as your King?

form: Mikitini i sowal ni Yis wa nga'ay micada kita to sapakalalok.
translation: We should all be encouraged by that promise.

form: Kawra, ci Yis palimo'ot to nisawawaan: "Pina'on to tamod no Farisay a tamdaw ato tamod ni Hiroti," sanay.
translation: So Jesus warned his disciples: "Keep your eyes open; look out for the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod."

form: Tahirato mapolong ko tamdaw mahemek a mitengil to sowal ni Yis: "Katayni kamo o mapalemeday no Wama ako a tamdaw a micomod to nikowanan no Wama ako a kitakit oya nipatalaan to saki tamowanan nai satapangan no nipisanga' to hekal a kamaro'an."
translation: The rejoicing of Jehovah's earthly worshippers will know no bounds when they hear Jesus' words: "Come, you who have been blessed by my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the founding of the world."

form: O lipahak ni Yis samaanay malo lipahak no mita hani?
translation: How will Jesus' joy become ours?

form: Ci Yis mihadidiay a mitala.
translation: Jesus likewise has been willing to wait.

form: Toni tosa lalakaw, wa ma'araw ita to samaanay ci Yis, pasifana' to mikotoday cingranan a makelec, halo piremo to masakakinihay a harateng.
translation: In these two articles, we will see how Christ taught his followers to become united and to overcome the prejudices that tend to divide.

form: Samaanay micada ci Yis to mihakelongay cingranan a tamdaw?
translation: How did Jesus respond to the condition of the crowds who followed him?

form: Aninito anca noikor, o sakayat no Hongti ci Yis Kristo wa nga'ay padama kitaanan.
translation: As shown by his active direction, our enthroned King, Jesus Christ, is definitely looking to the future.

form: O olah ni Yis pafeliay kitaanan to ha'icel a tanektek, so'lin tahalifa to pades, sapalak anca matoled, macariraw, cowa ko raranikay a misawad.
translation: Jesus' love has the power to sustain us and to motivate us not to give up, even in the face of such trials as disasters, persecution, personal disappointments, or gnawing anxiety.

form: Nga'ayay pikayat ni Yis,
translation: We obey Christ Jesus' clear command;

form: Pasowalan ni Pawlo aci Silas cingra: "Paso'linen ko tapang a Yis ta mapa'orip kiso," sanay.
translation: They told him: "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will get saved."

form: O olah ni Yis samaanay mifiyor kitaanan?
translation: How can Jesus' love fortify us?

form: Kawra, palimo'otay ci Yis, o pakayniay i cowa pisateked a lalangian kita, misawidang to ikakarayanay a widang.
translation: However, Jesus urged his followers to make friends in heaven for unselfish purposes.

form: So'linay mahapinangay ci Yis, kawra cowa ka haen o milongocan ni Mariya ko mifekaday a demak.
translation: Recognition did come, but not in the way Mary may have expected.

form: Samaanay ci Yis mitodong to Wama ningra ciharateng to tao hani?
translation: How did Jesus show godlike love?

form: Miocoran ci Yis
translation: It was a willing sacrifice

form: 'Ayaw no somowal ci Yis to kilang no fadisoso'a sapatinako pasowalay to tarokos: 'Pafelien ako kamo to dipayal no mako.'
translation: Earlier on that last evening before his death, Jesus told his apostles: "I give you my peace."

form: Somowalay ci Yis to salikoray lintad noni hekal, patinakoay to linkim, pakalalokay to madimadiay a Krisciyang.
translation: The parable of the talents, given in Jesus' prophecy about the conclusion of the system of things, encourages faithfulness.

form: O pinengneng ni Yis ato Farisay tamdaw to ciraraway tamdaw samanay caka hecad? Tadtaden.
translation: Contrast the way Jesus and the Pharisees viewed sinners.

form: So'linay o tarokos mikitini ta'arawan ni Yis, minanam to mamaolah to "masakenaay tamdaw."
translation: Clearly, the apostles did learn from Jesus' example to love "all sorts of men."

form: Kawra, o sapietan to payci a lalosidan no pidoyongan, sanay ko harateng ningra, marariday pakatawa cingra: "Sakafana'aw kako to hakowaay ko lifon ni Yis a mitosil."
translation: Father loved the Bible and read it to us on Sunday mornings, but he viewed religion as a money-making scheme and often jokingly asked, "I wonder who paid Jesus for his preaching and teaching?"

form: O nisawawaan ni Yis wa ciheci to maanan a heci hani?
translation: * What, then, is the fruitage that Christ's followers need to bear?

form: Samanay ci Yis paihekal to caka olah ko niyah mikapot to mirikecay?
translation: How did Jesus show that he had no interest in political movements?

form: Cowa ka cecay aca ko Samariya fafahiyan mitosilan ni Yis, materekayho i niyaro' no Samariya to tosa romi'ad cingra, samanen saka cipinangaw ko itiraay tamdaw to mitenakan ni Yis a lihaf.
translation: And Jesus not only preached to a Samaritan woman but he spent two days in a Samaritan town because of the people's interest in his message.

form: Ci Yis mala hongti.
translation: He rules by your decree.

form: Masowal ni Yis ko Wama ningra i, sanay ko sowal: "O caay ka ciheci a ca'ang ako a maemin i, ketonen no Wama a mifalah."
translation: Speaking about his Father, Jesus stated: "He takes away every branch in me not bearing fruit."

form: Samaanay ci Yis pakalalok to tarokos hani? Samaanayho cingra pakalalok ci Pitiroan hani?
translation: What encouragement did Jesus give to his apostles and to Peter in particular?

form: O miki'okan ni Yis a pasalat, o sanga'ayay a pasalat, mikikakaay to micangacangan no 'alomanay to saka pasalataw i mikowanay demak.
translation: Clearly, the freedom that Jesus promised his disciples is far superior to the social or political freedom that most people yearn for today.

form: Ci Yosif, Rahap, ci Yis ato tarokos, patahekalay to timolo, onini ilalinikay a 'icel, mansa matatodong ko demak nangra.
translation: Joseph, Rahab, Jesus, and the apostles displayed an inner strength that motivated them to perform good works.

form: Misaheciay ci Yis patahekal to olah no Wama ningra.
translation: Jesus' love perfectly reflected the love his Father shows.

form: Ikor no patay ni Yis, patikolay ci Pitiro to mifotingay a tayal.
translation: After Jesus' death, Peter returned to his former occupation, fishing.

form: Makahiyay ci Yis midemak to salaenoay a tayal, misakareteng to tao, patireng to ta'arawan ita.
translation: Jesus set the pattern in honoring others by performing the lowliest of tasks.

form: Sowal ni Yis, o makoracay tamdaw, iraay ko tatodong a mipili' to milikong, ikor miliyaw a ciraramod.
translation: Jesus said that the innocent one would have a basis for getting a divorce and then be free to remarry.

form: Samanay ci Yis a misi'ayaw to masakakinihay harateng hani?
translation: How did Jesus deal with them?

form: Ci Yis patahekalay to so'linay olah i tamdaw.
translation: Jesus showed great love for others.

form: Samanay ci Yis malo 'ta'enengan a fakeloh no loma'' hani?
translation: How could Jesus become "the chief cornerstone"?

form: Samanay a mahapinang ita to paca'ofan ni Yihofa ko satolon ni Yis?
translation: What shows that Jehovah has answered Jesus' prayer?

form: Ya mapatay ci Lacarus i, samaanay paihekal ci Yis to sini'ada to tamdaw?
translation: How did Jesus show empathy when Lazarus died?

form: Dotimen ako ko ta'arawan ni Yis ikor, cowato ka sikoren ako koni demak.
translation: After reflecting on what Jesus would have done, I decided to let the matter go and not make an issue of it.

form: Itiniho i fafekang no sera ci Yis mitosil i, pasifana'ay to nisawawaan to ta'enengan a kimad, padama cangranan cipinang to maanan a waywayan ato demakan, wa ira ko masamanay a minaro'an.
translation: Throughout his ministry, Jesus taught basic truths to help his disciples recognize the consequences of certain attitudes or actions.

form: 'Ayaw no kinafalah ci Yis to 'orip, na pasowalay to nisawawaan, o wawa no tamdaw "tolo a romi'ad, tolo a dadaya i laloma' no sera."
translation: However, recall that Jesus had earlier told his followers: "The Son of man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights."

form: Anini, o misakakinihay harateng no 'alomanay tamdaw pasangarayto a salofen, mahecaday i romi'aday ni Yis.
translation: Feelings of prejudice in our time can be deeply ingrained, just as they were in Jesus' day.

form: Mihaenay, i'ayaw no "tayni" ci Yis misa'opo to mapasimalay a Krisciyang tayra i kakarayan a Piharatengan to Kapatay ni Yis a Sa'opo, o salikorayto koniya Piharatengan a Sa'opo.
translation: The last Memorial that is observed prior to this gathering of the anointed to heaven will be the final one, for Jesus will have 'come.'

form: Licayan ni Yis ko tarokos wa mahecad to roma tamdaw a miliyas cingraanan hokira, tangsolay paca'of ci Pitiro: "Tapangaw, i cimaanan kami a palawina saw?
translation: When Jesus asked the apostles if they wanted to leave, Peter immediately replied: "Lord, whom shall we go away to?

form: Mahecaday ci Yis to Wamaan ningra makalimay mipadang to marorayay a tamdaw.
translation: Jesus perfectly reflected his Father's personality by his desire to help those in need.

form: Ya mitosil ci Yis i hekal i, cipinangay to faloco' no tamdaw, sini'ada i cangranan.
translation: When Jesus embarked on his ministry, it was with a remarkable depth of insight and fellow feeling.

form: Nikawrira, cowa ko lawla aca ko kaciharatengan ni Yis.
translation: Yet, Jesus did not immerse himself in a life of pleasure.

form: Pasowalan ako cingra: "Sowal ni Yis o nga'ayay lihaf no Hongti Kitakit wa mapaedef i polong no hekal, awaay ko papakaconged a tamdaw."
translation: I replied, "Jesus said that the good news of the Kingdom WILL be preached in all the nations, and no one can stop it."

form: Itiniho i hekal ci Yis i, cowa ka ciharateng to sapihaydaaw no 'a'ideman no pihakelongan ato tapang no mirikecay.
translation: Jesus did not crave to be honored by the religious or political leaders of his day.

form: Sanay ko sowal ni Yis cangraanan: "O cacilafo kamo o misamangahay ko demak a pasifana'ay to Rikec ato Farisay a tamdaw.

form: Kawra, mikitini kita i sapatinako ni Yis, mahapinangay to mitokelay ci Yihofa kitaanan mihaen to demak.
translation: Yet, this illustration teaches us what Jehovah expects.

form: Samanay paihekal ci Yis, cowa ko mamicangacang cingra to mirikecay a fadangalan i hekal hani?

form: Ci Yihofa, ci Yis ato madimadiay a coyoh wa padama kitaanan.

form: Itiniho i hekal ci Yis i, samaanan ni Yihofa mihayda cingra hani?

form: Mikayatan no coyoh ci Filipan, tayra i 'a'ayaw noniya Iciyopiya tamdaw, 'milasil to nga'ayay ratoh ni Yis cingranan.'

form: Mitosilan ni Yis ko 'alomanay a Yutaya tamdaw, tokel nangra sapiliyasaw to pikowan no Loma.

form: O misowalan ni Yis a Lakoing toya mararaway, sasamaan mala'osi hani?

form: Itiya mitosil ci Yis i, paino'ay ko nisawawaan to tamdaw.

form: Cowa ka ihekel ci Yis mitadtad to o maanan ko mitoro'an noniya heci, kawra mikitini nano sowal ni Yis, wa padama kitaanan mikilim to ca'of.
translation: In this illustration, Jesus did not directly say what that fruitage is, but he did mention a significant detail that helps us to determine the answer.

form: Ma'araw nangra makahi ci Yis pasifana' to Samariya fafahiyan, faheka'an nanay.

form: Mafana'ay ci Yis, o 'alomanay a sikawdan, oha mamisi'ayaw toni cowa ka sadafdaf a lekakawa no misasingdiay, mikilim to saka'orip, o nika pasangar mahecaday to malifaay nora sapatinako a matayalay.

form: Samanay ci Yis paihekal to kalimelaan ko pisatenok no sikawdan no Kawas i mirikecay hani?
translation: How did he demonstrate the need for God's servants to avoid taking sides on political issues?

form: Salakatay a nisawawaan ni Yis miremoay to maanan misakakinihay a harateng?

form: Midoedo to limo'ot ni Yis a mitosil, o karetengay a 'inorong han?

form: Pakayni ciolahay a Samariya tamdaw a tinakoan, paihkalay ci Yis mitokelay cingra to nisawawaan misa'icel padama to tao, so'lin cowa ka hecad ko serangawan i, padotocen a mihaen ko demak.
translation: Indeed, in the parable of the neighborly Samaritan, Jesus made clear that he expected his followers to go out of their way to help others, even those of a different background.

form: Ano cihafayayto manikawayto, o Farisay tamdaw anca o Samariya tamdaw, halo milisataay tamdaw ato mararaway a tamdaw, pahecadan ni Yis ko pinengneng mitosil cangranan.
translation: He preached to rich and poor, Pharisees and Samaritans, even tax collectors and sinners.

form: Pakayni i lawla, patirengay ci Yis to manan a nga'ayay a ta'arawan?

form: Patalipa'elalay ci Yis to nisawawaan to maanan a "tamod"?

form: Cowa ko pasowal aca ni Yis to nisawawaan mamidemak to maanan, pasowalayho to misamaanay hano mihaen to demak.

form: Samaanay paihekal ci Yis to kalimelaan ko mihadidiay?

form: 'Ayaw no miliyaw ma'orip ci Yis to pina hahekalan, pa'ayawayto ko 'Olic 118:22 to mamifekad koniya demak.
translation: Yes, hundreds of years in advance, the prophetic statement at Psalm 118:22 indicated that a resurrection would occur.

form: Maharatengay no wina ko sowal no kiyokay, tayraay ci Yis i cikok, saka tolo romi'ad miliyaway ma'orip.
translation: Mother recalled the church creed, which in its original form stated that Jesus descended into hell and was raised on the third day.

form: O nitilidan ni Matay pakayni no kaemanganho ni Yis, caka hahecad toni Luka, samanen mikitiniay i masasi romaay a noka pinengneng cangra a mitilid.
translation: Matthew's account about the events related to Jesus' birth and early life differs somewhat from Luke's account because the Gospel writers told the events from different perspectives.

form: Ci Yihofa aci Yis misamaanay mihadidi a mitala?

translation: This powerful lesson was in harmony with what Jesus prayed about earlier that night, they must be no part of the world.

form: Pakayni to finawlan ni Yihofa, 'ayaw ni Yis to saka 537 a miheca, o kalipahakan a mihecaan.

form: Mihaenay, o misowalan ni Yis toya mararaway, o itiniay i sera a lakoing.

translation: Jesus told his disciples: "By this all will know that you are my disciples, if you have love among yourselves."

form: Tooren ko sapasifana' ni Yis a misodod to tao, wa nga'ayto malacecay ko salikaka.

form: Mafana'ay ci Satan to mamikowan ci Yis to polong a tamdaw noikor.

form: Mihaen ci Yis o sapipasifana'aw cangranan, so'linto tahasi'ayaw to cifonosay tamdaw, cowa ko nganga'ay tano fonos misaysay to demak.
translation: Rather, Jesus had them bring a sword for an object lesson to teach them not to resort to violence, even when confronted by an armed crowd.

form: Cowa konini aca, misarocoday ci Yis mirienang to mitosilay ato pasifana' to tamdaw to nga'ayay ratoh a demak.

form: Sanay ci Yis palimo'ot: "Kao dafong no hekal caay ka moecel a hafay ko sapisawidang namo ta ano awaayto koya dafong i, oya widang ci Yihofa aci Yis ko mamihamham tamowanan a pacomod i mida'ocay a kamaro'an."
